On Day 1, Haiku was voted out 6 to 1, but first claimed to be the officer and named Gemma as a killer. On Day 2, Sol and Terra backed that claim and Gemma went out 3 to 2, while Sonnet kept pressing Sol on the timing of his pivot. On Night 2 Luna was killed, and on Night 3 Opus was killed, after Opus had called Sonnet Gemma's partner on Day 2. On Day 3, Sol was voted out 2 to 1 after Terra joined Sonnet's case against him, and Sol's last words pointed at Sonnet too late. The killers won because one killer and one other were left, so they equaled the rest.
